Also audited Lou (32) PASS and Winston (15) PASS.
feed.next_up: Fix the TIE path Maximo (302) Nap instance (line ~7456) — same Wisp block and Sandwiches mirror are missing there, but the tie path has no win/lose team structure so it needs inline `hasSideline(opp(team), 344)` and `hasSideline(opp(team), 33)` checks rather than the existing flags.

feed.roast: Five months to Kickstarter and we're still retrofitting Wisp blocks onto forEach loops like it's a craft fair — Rosewater would call this "elegant," I call it "the interaction matrix finally getting the beating it deserved in January.

feed.summary: Gus (31) Gale Force now correctly lets the losing player CHOOSE which sideline ghost to swap in — previously it auto-picked the first available ghost via `findIndex`. Added a `#galeForcePickerOverlay` modal (same Winston Scheme pattern) that fires after the ability queue drains; the picker shows all viable sideline ghosts with HP and ability info; the losing player clicks their choice, entry effects fire for the new ghost, then the game continues. Also fixed: old code never called `triggerEntry()` for the forced-in ghost — the new picker and auto-pick (1 sideline case) both fire `triggerEntry`.
feed.next_up: Audit Lou (32) Bros — sideline effect that boosts Grawr (+1 dmg + heal); verify Cornelius block, Filbert curse, and that the `wF.id === 34` check is correct.
feed.after_that: Audit Sandwiches (33) Dependable — resource mirror for all resource grants; verify all 14+ grant sites are covered and that none were missed in recent additions (Tadpole Splash, etc.).
feed.roast: Five months past the Kickstarter deadline and you're just now letting players pick their own ghost on a forced swap — congratulations on discovering agency, Garfield wept.

feed.summary: Dream Cat (28) Jinx now fires on tie rounds where both teams rolled doubles — was completely missing from the tie path despite being present in win/lose path.
feed.next_up: Audit Gus (31) Gale Force — spec says "force your opponent to CHOOSE a different ghost from their sideline" but current implementation auto-picks the first available sideline ghost via `findIndex` rather than showing a picker modal to the losing player.
feed.after_that: Audit Lou (32) Bros and Sandwiches (33) Dependable — the last two unaudited Common cards; Lou's Grawr synergy (+1 dmg +1 HP when Lou is sideline and Grawr wins) and Sandwiches' resource mirror (already referenced throughout the code as `sandwichForWin` but needs formal verification that all resource grants are covered).
feed.roast: Eight months past the Kickstarter deadline and you're still finding Jinx code paths that forgot ties exist — Rosewater would call that "elegant incompleteness," I call it Tuesday.

feed.summary: Fixed Suspicious Jeff (61) Snicker missing Cornelius (45) Antidote block — sideline die-theft now respects the established pattern where Cornelius on the enemy sideline blocks all sideline penalties, consistent with Cyboo Spark, Shoo Alpine Air, and Needle Big Bro.
feed.next_up: Audit Ancient Librarian (3) Knowledge — next unaudited Common card; need to find its abilityDesc in the GHOSTS array and verify the implementation fires at the right time and does the right thing.
feed.after_that: Audit Fang Outside (6) and Fang Undercover (7) — likely a dual-card mechanic (similar to Tweak and Twonk pattern) that may have interaction bugs if both Fangs are on the same team.
feed.roast: Four months from the Kickstarter and we're still teaching the cards to read each other's rulebook — Cornelius has been the designated "no" guy since the beta, Jeff.

feed.summary: Fixed ReferenceError crash in Masked Hero (55) Underdog counter vs Shade's Shadow — the Shade's Shadow forEach in doPreRollSetup was the only pre-roll forEach block missing `const f = active(team)`, causing a crash whenever Shade's Shadow chipped an active Masked Hero.
feed.next_up: Audit Chad (56) — next unaudited Frost Valley Uncommon; need to find its abilityDesc in the GHOSTS array and verify the implementation matches spec.
feed.after_that: Audit Marcus (57) and Ashley (58) — Ashley's Burning Soul (+1 Sacred Fire on win) was already seen referenced at line 9170 in the code during the Roger audit, so its implementation exists but needs formal verification against spec.
feed.roast: Five months from Kickstarter and we're still fixing crashes caused by one missing `const f = active(team)` that every other forEach block in the file already had — chef's kiss copy-paste discipline.

feed.summary: Nicholas (51) Sneak Attack now correctly fires Knight Terror/Light reactions after its entry damage, using the enemy team as the ability-team so the entering ghost can counter-react rather than being double-punished.
feed.next_up: Audit Bogey (53) — Bogus (reflect all incoming damage once per game); this is a defensive reactive ability that modifies `dmg` in the damage resolution path and was referenced as an interaction point in Bandit Pete and other cards but has never been formally verified.
feed.after_that: Audit Roger (54) Tempest (two pairs of doubles = 3 Sacred Fires) and Masked Hero (55) Underdog (deal 3 damage when enemy uses a before-rolling effect) — both are in the unaudited Frost Valley cluster and Masked Hero's anti-pre-roll trigger has wide interaction surface.
feed.roast: Six months from Kickstarter and you're patching the order-of-operations on a card's entry trigger so Nicholas doesn't get karmically kneecapped — Rosewater would call that "fixing the shark in the tank" while the boat's still on fire.

feed.summary: Fixed Jackson (50) Regrow — rerolled die was silently discarded every round; switched to in-place mutation on B.preRoll.*.dice (same Sonya/Jeanie/DarkWing pattern) so resolveRound actually uses the rerolled value.
feed.next_up: Audit Nicholas (51) and Hugo (52) — the two Dark Castle Uncommons; Hugo's Wreckage (triples = deal double damage + remove 1 die next round) is referenced as an interaction point elsewhere in the code but hasn't been verified against spec.
feed.after_that: Audit Bogey (53) through Suspicious Jeff (61) — the full Frost Valley cluster; Bogey and Masked Hero have dedicated implementation blocks referenced in the code but neither has been audited for trigger correctness.
feed.roast: Six months past the Kickstarter deadline and you just discovered Jackson's signature ability has been quietly flushing its reroll down the toilet — at least the bug was consistent, which is more than I can say for your shipping schedule.

feed.summary: Fixed Needle (21) Big Bro missing Cornelius (45) Antidote block — the +1 die for Buttons always fired even when enemy had Cornelius on sideline, making Cornelius ineffective against the Needle+Buttons synergy.
feed.next_up: Audit Hermit (47) Solitude — entry-triggered HP scaling based on total KO'd ghosts on both teams; verify the KO count logic is correct and fires in `triggerEntry()`, that it's capped at `maxHp`, and that late-game entry (when 3+ ghosts are KO'd) gives the correct bonus.
feed.after_that: Audit Greg (49) and Jackson (50) — both Dark Castle Uncommons not yet verified; Greg's ability is unknown until we check the GHOSTS array; Jackson is a post-roll dice mutator referenced in the post-roll chain order (`afterJackson`) so its implementation should be verifiable.
feed.roast: Four months from Kickstarter and you just noticed Cornelius has been cosplaying as furniture while Needle and Buttons ran a protection racket on him.

feed.summary: Fixed Nikon (2) Ambush and Cave Dweller (46) Lurk "first roll" check — replaced `B.round === 1` (broken for KO-swap replacements) with per-ghost `_rolledOnce` flag so any ghost entering mid-battle via KO swap still correctly fires their first-roll ability when they win their opening round.
feed.next_up: Audit Outlaw (43) Thief — the die-steal mechanic (doubles tie → steal 1 enemy die next roll) has a dedicated implementation block in doPreRollSetup; need to verify the per-team state tracking, that it stacks correctly with Suspicious Jeff (61) Snicker and Hugo (52) Wreckage, and that the penalty flag is correctly consumed and reset each round.
feed.after_that: Audit Bubble Boys (44) Pop and Cornelius (45) Antidote — Bubble Boys' "opponent triples → instant KO" is a reactive trigger that must fire at the right point in resolveRound; Cornelius blocks MANY sideline effects and any missed negation is a design flaw affecting multiple card interactions.
feed.roast: Two months from Kickstarter and you're just now discovering that "first round" and "first round for this specific ghost" are different concepts — Rosewater wrote about this exact trap in 2003, Wyatt.

feed.summary: Mallow (89) Dozy Cozy +3 HP heal now capped at maxHp — `f.hp += 3` → `Math.min(f.maxHp, f.hp + 3)`, plus modal preview updated to show capped value (same fix pattern as Katrina v280 and Troubling Haters v285).
feed.next_up: Audit Calvin & Anna (91) Toboggan — spec says "When you defeat a Ghost, you may switch Calvin & Anna with a ghost from your sideline"; need to verify the kill-triggered swap modal fires correctly in the KO/handleKOs section, that the incoming ghost enters at full HP (consistent with doKoSwap), and that the once-per-use or every-kill semantics match spec.
feed.after_that: Audit Uncommon tier starting at Grawr (34) — Menace (entry damage, already PASS per v281) then Larry (35) Flying Kick (triples → 3× damage), Bill & Bob (36) Bait n Switch (below 4 HP → 2× damage), Dealer (37), Alucard (38) — first five Set 1 Uncommons that have never been verified.
feed.roast: Third time patching the exact same overheal bug is less "polish" and more "maybe read your own commit history before September, champ.

feed.summary: Jeanie (90) Hidden Treasure forced reroll was silently discarded — `doJeanieChoice` wrote a new dice array to `B.pendingResolve` and `B.redDice/blueDice`, but `postRollDone()` (which runs after Jeanie) overwrote `B.pendingResolve` with `B.preRoll.*.dice` references that Jeanie never updated. Fixed by in-place `.splice()` on `B.preRoll.*.dice` (same Dark Wing/Sonya pattern), so the closure already has the new values when `postRollDone` runs.
feed.next_up: Audit Eloise (85) Change of Heart — pre-roll HP swap for 1 Ice Shard; need to verify the swap is symmetric, HP cap behavior (should the new HP be capped at maxHp or truly swapped raw?), and that the continuation/Selene chain is called correctly after the modal resolves.
feed.after_that: Audit Mallow (89) Dozy Cozy — sideline Sacred Fire-to-HP modal; verify the fire resource is properly decremented, HP is capped, Filbert curse flips to damage, and that it fires at the right point in doPreRollSetup.
feed.roast: Three cards deep into the same closure bug and you're still rediscovering "mutate the array Rosewater himself warned you about" — at this rate Jeanie's Hidden Treasure will ship in October.

feed.summary: Sonya (69) Mesmerize die change was silently discarded every round — `pickSonyaDie` created a new array copy that `postRollDone` immediately overwrote; fixed by mutating `B.preRoll.red.dice` in-place (same Dark Wing pattern) so the closure sees the change.
feed.next_up: Audit Sky (72) — next unaudited Rare card; need to find its abilityDesc in the GHOSTS array and verify the implementation matches spec.
feed.after_that: Audit Flora (75), Dark Wing (76), and City Cyboo (77) — all three are in the Rare tier, marked NEEDS AUDIT, and may have similar closure/mutation bugs given they're post-roll dice modifiers.
feed.roast: Five months to Kickstarter and we just discovered that Sonya's signature ability has been quietly committing sudoku every round because someone forgot JavaScript passes references like a hot potato — at least Dark Wing left you a recipe.

feed.summary: Kairan (68) Let's Dance — bonus +1 die no longer transfers to a different ghost if Kairan was KO'd or swapped after earning it; moved `redCount/blueCount +=` inside the Kairan-is-active guard so the die is personal to Kairan and silently discarded otherwise.
feed.next_up: Audit Sonya (69) Mesmerize — post-roll die-change modal (once per roll, change a die to a 2); verify it fires after BOTH teams roll, that `sonyaUsedThisRound` resets correctly each round, and that the die substitution is properly reflected in the resolve calculation.
feed.after_that: Audit Sky (72) and then Dark Wing (76) Precision (reroll until doubles) — both structurally complex and most likely to have bugs in the trigger/flow.
feed.roast: That's not a fix. That's a bandaid on a bandaid. Buttons has more structural integrity.

feed.summary: Splinter (101) Toxic Fumes now shows a cinematic TOXIC FUMES! callout when she first wins and activates — previously the activation was invisible (only a log entry), leaving players confused why chip damage started appearing with no announcement.
feed.next_up: Audit Raditz (62), Doug (63), Sparky (64) — the first three unaudited Rare cards. Sparky's Tinder (1s deal +3 damage each) has a triggered local `sparkyTriggered` variable visible in the code around line 8034, so it likely has a cinematic callout, but the trigger condition and interaction with Drizzle (removes 1s before the roll) needs verification.
feed.after_that: Audit Snorton (67), Kairan (68), Sonya (69) — the next Rare tier cluster. Snorton's Fissure (two 6s → +5 damage) has `snortonTriggered` in the cinematic section but needs its trigger condition verified; Sonya's ability is unknown until we check the GHOSTS array entry.
feed.roast: Five months from Kickstarter and we're just now telling players why they're taking damage — Rosewater calls that "invisible information," I call it Tuesday at your studio.

feed.summary: Piper (107) Slick Coat now correctly negates ALL enemy before-rolling effects (Death Howl Pressure, Wick Slow Burn, Ember Force, Shade's Shadow, Tyson Hop, etc.) by adding Piper's active-ghost check to `dylanNegates()` — previously she only blocked Romy's prediction modal and Shade's Haunt via isolated inner checks, leaving ~11 other pre-roll effects completely unaffected.
feed.next_up: Audit Cyboo (100) Spark and Splinter (101) — both Set 1 Ghost-Rares still marked NEEDS AUDIT. Cyboo's Spark (sideline +1 die when active ghost has <3 HP) was seen with implementation at line 5992 but not formally verified; Splinter's ability is unknown until I check the GHOSTS array.
feed.after_that: Audit Uncommon tier — Larry (35) Flying Kick (triples → 3X damage), Bill & Bob (36) Bait n Switch (below 4 HP → 2X), and Dealer (37) to verify their trigger conditions are faithful to spec before moving further down the uncommon list.
feed.roast: Eleven other cards were silently ignoring Piper for who knows how long and you're framing this as "Slick Coat now correctly negates" instead of "Piper has been a fraud since playtest one" — Rosewater would call that a feel-bad bug, Skaff would call it a balance crater, I call it Tuesday.

feed.summary: Katrina (70) Seeker heal now capped at maxHp — fixed uncapped `f.hp += 1` that allowed 6/5 HP overflow when opponent had more HP than Katrina's max.
feed.next_up: Audit Rare tier cards that haven't been checked yet — Dark Jeff (74) Cackle (sideline +1 damage all rolls), Flora (75) Restore (doubles heal on win or loss), Dark Wing (76) Precision (reroll until doubles) — these 3 are structurally complex and most likely to have bugs.
feed.after_that: Audit Uncommon cards — Grawr (34) Menace (entry damage, verify it fires in triggerEntry), Larry (35) Flying Kick (triples 3X — need to verify against boobattles ref), Bill & Bob (36) Bait n Switch (below 4 HP 2X damage — verify the HP threshold fires correctly).
feed.roast: Six months past the September deadline and you're just now noticing Katrina could heal past her own max HP — Rosewater calls that "discovering the rules of your own game.

feed.summary: Fixed "even doubles" trigger for both Chip (16) Acrobatic Dive and Admiral (71) Comrades — replaced the buggy `winDice.every(d => d % 2 === 0)` check (requires ALL dice even) with the correct `wR.value % 2 === 0` (requires only the paired value to be even), so rolls like [4,4,3] now correctly activate both abilities.
feed.next_up: Audit Villager (11) Hospitality and Jeffery (14) Chuckle more carefully — their specs say "every winning roll" grants HP, but the current implementation lives inside the win-path `resolveRound`. Need to verify they correctly handle the Filbert curse case (Filbert flips heals → damage) and whether they fire when the ACTIVE ghost wins vs. when ANY roll wins.
feed.after_that: Audit Boo Brothers (17) Teamwork — spec says "Before rolling, may remove 1 die to gain 1 HP." The current pre-roll modal implementation should be verified: does it fire every round, correctly respect the 2-die minimum, and properly track HP cap at maxHp?
feed.roast: Two cards shipped broken with the same copy-pasted bug for who knows how long, and somehow "every die must be even" passed code review — Rosewater would call this a failure of New World Order, I call it Tuesday.

feed.summary: Tommy Salami (30) Regulator now actually mutates opponent dice (5s/6s → low values) before winner determination, matching the spec and boobattles implementation — previously it only counted high dice after the fact.
feed.next_up: Audit Common cards — Wanderer (4) is NEEDS ARCHITECTURE (no hidden sideline mechanic in testroom); next up is Ancient Librarian (3) or Kodako (1) to verify their implementations match spec.
feed.after_that: Continue systematic ghost-rare audit: Skylar (104) Winter Barrage needs verification that ice shard damage scaling actually uses `×2` per shard; Tyler (105) Sacred Fire doubling needs audit against spec.
feed.roast: Six months from Kickstarter and Tommy Salami is just now learning that "regulate" means actually touching the dice, not politely judging them from across the table.

feed.summary: Implemented Patches (354) — Quilt: pre-roll `#patchesQuiltOverlay` modal fires when Patches is active with ≥2 Healing Seeds; YES spends 2 seeds and arms a full damage-negation shield; `QUILT!` callout in earthy brown queued in the cinematic section after `GEM ARMOR!`; Cameron Force of Nature correctly destroys Patches on a negate; full cleanup in tie/win-path resets and `clearAllOverlays()`. Rolling Hills' defensive counterpart to Volcanic Activity's Pyrope Gem Armor (Seeds vs Surge as the economy cost).
feed.next_up: Implement Glow Worm (351) — Tunnel: spend 1 Surge to freely swap your active ghost (no entry effects trigger). Pre-roll Surge-powered swap modal with a ghost-picker, `B.glowWormDecided[team]` per-round flag, `doGlowWormChoice` that swaps `activeIdx` to the chosen ghost WITHOUT calling `triggerEntry`, `TUNNEL!` callout in `var(--common)`.
feed.after_that: Implement Riverbed (356) — Current: sideline passive — if the opponent rolls doubles, force them to reroll one die. Post-roll check: `hasSideline(loseTeam, 356) && wR.type === 'doubles'` → pick one of the winner's dice at random and reroll it (mutating `B.preRoll` dice before `resolveRound` is called), with `CURRENT!` callout in `var(--rare)` showing the changed die.
feed.roast: That's not a fix. That's a bandaid on a bandaid. Buttons has more structural integrity.

feed.summary: Implemented Old Mill (322) — Grindstone: pre-roll `#oldMillOverlay` modal fires each round when Old Mill is active with ≥2 Surge; YES spends 2 Surge and grants 1 Moonstone immediately before rolling with a `GRINDSTONE!` callout in `var(--rare)`, completing the full Volcanic Activity/Rolling Hills resource-conversion ecosystem (Surge → Moonstone bridge).
feed.next_up: Implement Smelt (320) — Forge: check the GHOSTS array `abilityDesc` for Smelt's ability (likely a Surge-to-damage or fire-to-damage conversion mechanic) and port as the next Rolling Hills/Volcanic Activity card with battle logic.
feed.after_that: Implement the remaining unimplemented Rolling Hills/Volcanic Activity cards — audit the GHOSTS array for IDs in the 316–370 range with `abilityDesc` entries not yet in FIXLOG; candidates include any remaining uncommons/rares with clear win/entry/sideline trigger patterns like a fire-themed common, a Healing Seed on-loss card, or a doubles-triggered resource grant.
feed.roast: Three cards to complete a "resource-conversion ecosystem" and it still won't grind out a finished Kickstarter by September — Rosewater would call that a mechanic, Garfield would call it a detour.

feed.summary: Implemented Wisp (344) — Guide Light: sideline passive resource denial — when Wisp is benched, all 20 opponent resource-grant sites (Sacred Fire, Ice Shard, Healing Seed, Surge, Lucky Stone, Moonstone across win/lose/KO paths + Sandwiches mirrors) are blocked with a single `GUIDE LIGHT!` announcement per team per round; version bumped to v273.
feed.next_up: Implement Old Mill (322) — Grindstone: spend 2 Surge → gain 1 Moonstone before rolling; pre-roll `#oldMillOverlay` modal (gears/mill theme) fires when Old Mill is active with ≥2 Surge and `magnoliaBloomDecided`-style once-per-round flag; YES spends 2 Surge and grants 1 Moonstone with `GRINDSTONE!` callout in `var(--uncommon)` — the cross-economy bridge converting Surge surplus into Moonstone advantage.
feed.after_that: Implement the remaining unimplemented Rolling Hills / Volcanic Activity cards — check the GHOSTS array for IDs in 316–370 with `abilityDesc` entries not yet in FIXLOG; candidates include Driftwood (some ID), Smelt (320 if not already), and any remaining uncommons/rares with clear win/entry/sideline trigger patterns.
feed.roast: Twenty hook sites for a bench effect nobody will see because Wisp is on the bench — Rosewater would call that "invisible complexity," I call it a Tuesday with Wyatt.

feed.summary: Implemented Drizzle (328) — Rain Dance: when Drizzle is the active ghost on either team, all 1s from both teams are automatically rerolled (free, no modal) in the post-roll chain before Dark Wing fires — using in-place `B.preRoll.red/blue.dice` mutation so `resolveRound` correctly receives the updated dice; `RAIN DANCE!` callout in green shows both teams' new dice arrays.
feed.next_up: Implement Wisp (344) — Guide Light: while on the sideline, opponent cannot gain resources this round — `hasSideline(enemyTeam, 344)` flag computed at Phase 5 entry as `wispBlocksRes`, then added as a guard to every resource grant (Sacred Fire, Ice Shard, Healing Seed, Surge, Moonstone) in the win/lose/tie paths; single `GUIDE LIGHT!` announcement fires when it first blocks, remaining denials are silent.
feed.after_that: Implement Old Mill (322) — Grindstone: spend 2 Surge to gain 1 Moonstone — pre-roll modal (like Forge Fire Temper) fires when Old Mill is active with ≥2 Surge; `B.oldMillCharged[team]` flag; in `postRollDone` before moonstone check, if charged, spend 2 Surge and grant 1 Moonstone with `GRINDSTONE!` callout in Rolling Hills green — the cross-economy bridge card that converts Surge surplus into Moonstone advantage.
feed.roast: Oh splendid, you built a mandatory free-reroll aura that silently mutates both players' dice before they can even process what happened — Rosewater would call that "invisible gameplay," Garfield would call it "removing agency," and I'm calling it "Drizzle the Fun Eraser" two sentences in.

feed.summary: Implemented Slag Heap (339) — Residue: death-curse that blocks the killer from healing for 2 rounds — `RESIDUE!` callout fires on KO with an `onShow` that sets `B.slagHeapResidueRounds[winTeamName] = 2`; each subsequent round's `doPreRollSetup` decrements (2→1→0) and sets `B.slagHeapResidueActive[tName]` so Phase 5's `slagResidueBlocksWin` flag blocks all 10 win-team heal sources (Opa Rest win+tie, Villager Hospitality, Jeffery Chuckle, Biscuit Warm Up, Calvin Overclock, Flora Restore win, Growing Mob, Munch Scraps, Ancient One Friend to All tie) with inline `RESIDUE!` callouts in place of the heals.
feed.next_up: Implement the next unimplemented Volcanic Activity / Rolling Hills card — check the GHOSTS array for remaining IDs in the 316–370 range not yet in FIXLOG; likely candidates include Snapper (some ID near Tadpole), Lava Flow (ID around 350+), or any remaining common/uncommon with a clear win/entry/sideline trigger pattern.
feed.after_that: Continue through the remaining unimplemented VA/RH cards — after exhausting simple trigger cards, move to any remaining Set 1/Dark Castle/Frost Valley cards that may have been missed during the original 113-card implementation pass.
feed.roast: Ten healing sources audited and surgically neutered for a card that punishes you from the grave, and you still named the variable "slagHeapResidueRounds" like you're being paid by the syllable.

feed.summary: Implemented Ash Phoenix (361) — Rebirth: a two-round resurrection arc — KO fires `REBIRTH!` primer ("returns next round with 2 HP!") in the current round's cinematic queue; next round's `doPreRollSetup` resurrects the ghost to sideline at 2 HP via `preRollCallouts.unshift` so the `REBIRTH!` announcement fires first before any chip damage and the sideline updates show Ash Phoenix alive when roll buttons unlock.
feed.next_up: Implement Slag Heap (339) — Residue: when defeated, opponent's active ghost cannot heal for 2 rounds. Death-trigger debuff setting `B.slagHeapResidueRounds[enemyTeamName] = 2`; decrement each round in `doPreRollSetup`; all heal callouts check the counter and silently skip with `RESIDUE!` callout when active — covers Villager, Jeffery, Opa, Biscuit, Flora, Growing Mob, Munch Scraps, Ancient One.
feed.after_that: Implement more Volcanic Activity / Rolling Hills cards — check the GHOSTS array for remaining IDs in 316–370 with `abilityDesc` entries not yet in FIXLOG; candidates include any remaining uncommon/rare with a clear win/entry/sideline trigger pattern not yet covered.
feed.roast: A two-round `unshift` cinematic just to make a bird stand up — Rosewater would call it resonant, Skaff would call it a bug waiting for its second ability, and the Kickstarter calendar is calling it April.

feed.summary: Implemented Puff Ball (355) — Burst: when hit by doubles, Puff Ball explodes for 2 damage back to the attacker and self-KOs — `puffBallBurst` flag set in the game-state counter-damage section after Thistle Barbed (`lF.id === 355 && wR.type === 'doubles'`), winner takes 2 damage (KO-capable), Puff Ball self-destructs (hp=0/ko=true/killedBy=355), `BURST!` queued in `var(--common)` with `renderBattle()` onShow — a 3 HP Volcanic Activity kamikaze that punishes doubles-heavy strategies.
feed.next_up: Implement Ash Phoenix (361) — Rebirth: when defeated, returns to battle next round with 2 HP (once per game). Set `B.ashPhoenixUsed[team]` once-per-game flag; on KO (in on-lose cinematic queue), defer resurrection to next round's `doPreRollSetup` via `B.ashPhoenixRebirth[team]` flag — reset hp=2/ko=false, fire `REBIRTH!` in `var(--rare)` with `renderBattle()` onShow, similar to the Bo Miracle pattern but self-targeted.
feed.after_that: Implement Slag Heap (339) — Residue: when defeated, opponent's active ghost cannot heal for 2 rounds. Death-trigger debuff setting `B.slagHeapResidueRounds[enemyTeam] = 2`; decrement each round in `doPreRollSetup`; all heal callouts (Villager Hospitality, Jeffery Chuckle, Opa Rest, Biscuit Warm Up, Flora Restore, Growing Mob, Munch Scraps, Ancient One Friend to All) check the counter and silently skip with `RESIDUE!` callout when active.
feed.roast: Four months to Kickstarter and you built a card whose entire job is to die — finally, a mechanic that perfectly mirrors the project timeline.

feed.summary: Implemented Wick (349) — Slow Burn: pre-roll mutual pressure in `doPreRollSetup` — 1 chip to enemy (Dylan-negatable, Masked Hero-reactive) + 1 HP self-cost each round (self-KO prevented), bumped to v268.
feed.next_up: Implement Char's set-mate or next Rolling Hills/VA card — audit the GHOSTS array for remaining IDs in 316–370 with `abilityDesc` entries not yet in FIXLOG; candidates include any remaining uncommon/rare with a clear win/entry/sideline trigger pattern.
